svg.title: PayOps Sentinel
svg.desc: PayOps Sentinel: Investigates refund spikes and tries to disprove its own explanations first. Evidence: 26.9% → 2.8% false attributions, 360 held-out runs; 84 / 84 numeric claims matched their source query; 16 / 16 safety cases passed; 158 backend tests. Status: sandbox.
